messages.subject: Environmental Horizons | International ESG & Sustainability Executive | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Environmental Horizons Recruitment Team,

Your work across environmental management, sustainability and Saudi development aligns closely with my executive background in ESG, regulatory engagement and responsible natural resources. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate includes government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications. I have also supported stakeholder governance around large-scale renewable-energy deployment and operational carbon-data traceability.

I am seeking senior Saudi mandates where environmental strategy must connect with regulators, communities, operating teams and executive decision-making. Target roles include Director, Head or Senior Director positions across ESG, sustainability, external affairs, stakeholder relations and responsible business.

I am internationally mobile, available following a 30-day notice period, and require employer-supported work authorization. My three-page executive CV is attached for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
